units.source_text: 石阶上坡处，右侧是义照稻荷神社涂着刺眼的朱红色的神殿，还有一对用铁丝网围着的石派。

en.t: On the upward slope of the stone steps, to the right stood the shrine building of Yoshiteru Inari Shrine, painted in a glaring vermilion, and there was also a pair of stone figures enclosed by wire mesh.

units.source_text: 石狐嘴里叼着紫菜卷饭团，竖起尖锐的耳朵，耳朵里也涂上了朱红色。

en.t: The stone fox held a nori-wrapped rice ball in its mouth, its sharp ears standing upright, and the inside of the ears had also been painted vermilion.
